Dear Team,

Please be advised that an intermittent disruption has been identified in a service provided by one of our partners. Our team is closely monitoring the situation and will keep you informed of any relevant updates.

For further assistance, please contact support@monnetpayments.com.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience and understanding.

Best regards,
